_comment: Hand review of every curse for the Cursed Deck mode (2026-11-18, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-18-cursed-deck-design.md). Played with the Unholy Grimoire: exhausted (Grimoire damage to ALL enemies), then 'played' hits the chosen enemy. Upgraded (+): 'amount' becomes 'amountPlus' on both sides (selfVar is the card var raised for the player side), cost costPlus, Grimoire grimoirePlus. Curses whose effect only hits the player (no 'played' effect) are nerfed when upgraded instead: 'self' is [vanilla, upgraded] and inHandPlus says what changes (owner, 2026-11-18). tools/curse_table.py validates it and writes docs/review/cursed-curses.md.

BAD_LUCK.inHand: End of turn in hand: lose 13 HP
BAD_LUCK.note: Owner's example: -13 HP flat to the monster, 20 upgraded, on both sides

DECAY.inHand: End of turn in hand: take 2 damage
DECAY.note: Unpowered damage, Block stops it, like the vanilla side; doubled upgraded since 2 -> 3 is invisible

REGRET.inHand: End of turn in hand: lose 1 HP per card in hand
REGRET.note: Counts your hand after Regret left it; no var, the upgraded player side is a patch on its turn-end damage

DOUBT.inHand: End of turn in hand: gain 1 Weak

SHAME.inHand: End of turn in hand: gain 1 Frail
SHAME.note: Frail barely matters on monsters (few gain Block); Vulnerable is the attacker's version of the same malus

DEBT.inHand: End of turn in hand: lose 10 gold
DEBT.note: Monsters have no gold: the monster pays you. In Blood runs gold gains are 0, so it does nothing there

STS1_PAIN.inHand: While in hand: lose 1 HP whenever you play another card
STS1_PAIN.note: Enemy loses 1 HP per card you played this turn, Pain included; the mod owns the class, its +1 raises the HP lost

NORMALITY.inHand: While in hand: you can't play more than 3 cards this turn
NORMALITY.note: No monster version of a card limit: Grimoire only (5, 12 upgraded). Upgraded, the limit goes to 4 (owner, 2026-11-18)
NORMALITY.inHandPlus: While in hand: you can't play more than 4 cards this turn

ENTHRALLED.inHand: While in hand: must be played before other cards
ENTHRALLED.note: Already playable: keeps its cost 2, 0 upgraded (that's its nerf: forced first, but free); with the Grimoire it is exhausted on play (5 / 12)

SPORE_MIND.note: Already exhausts when played, so it already fed the Grimoire; 0 cost and 12 upgraded

CLUMSY.note: Owner's example of a curse with no effect: Grimoire only (5, 12 upgraded)

WRITHE.note: Grimoire only; Innate makes it a reliable opening hit

GUILTY.note: Grimoire only; the player-side nerf makes it leave sooner, so less fuel: a real trade

POOR_SLEEP.note: Grimoire only; Retain lets you hold it for the right turn

ASCENDERS_BANE.note: Grimoire only; it can be upgraded like the others

STS1_NECRONOMICURSE.inHand: When exhausted, comes back to your hand
STS1_NECRONOMICURSE.note: Exhausted on play then back in hand: replayable all turn. Upgraded it keeps cost 1 (at 0 it would loop forever); Grimoire 12 per energy; its return to the hand is fuel too, so no nerf

STS1_PARASITE.inHand: No effect; removed from the deck: lose 3 max HP
STS1_PARASITE.note: The parasite jumps: the enemy loses 3 max HP (and HP); upgraded, 5 on both sides (removing it costs you 5 max HP)

STS1_PRIDE.keywords: Innate, Exhaust; playable for 1 (StS1, to port)
STS1_PRIDE.inHand: End of turn in hand: put a copy on top of your draw pile
STS1_PRIDE.note: Already playable and exhausting; its copies are Grimoire fuel, so no nerf. Cost 0 and Grimoire 12 upgraded; the copies are +0
